q.description: [BETA] The natural-language query describing which rows to extract and what each row should contain.

operations.name: Research
operations.description: The `POST /research` method creates an asynchronous research task which can perform a comprehensive web research.

excludeDomains.description: The domains you want to exclude of the search. By default, don't restrict the search.

fromDate.description: The date from which the search results should be considered, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). It must be before `toDate`, if provided, and later than 1970-01-01.

includeDomains.description: The domains you want to search on. By default, don't restrict the search. You can provide up to 100 domains.

q.description: The natural language question for which you want to retrieve context.

structuredOutputSchema.description: Required only when `outputType` is `structured`. Provide a JSON schema (as a string) representing the desired response format. The root must be of type `object`.

toDate.description: The date until which the search results should be considered, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). It must be later than `fromDate`, if provided, or than 1970-01-01.

mode.description: Pin the research agent mode. Omit to let the agent auto-classify per request based on the question.

outputType.description: The type of output you want to get. Use `structured` for a custom-formatted response defined by `structuredOutputSchema`.

reasoningDepth.description: Pin the reasoning depth (S < M < L < XL). Defaults to L when omitted. Higher depths trade latency for thoroughness.

operations.description: The `/fetch` endpoint allows you to fetch a single webpage from a given URL.

extractImages.description: Defines whether the API should extract the images from the webpage in its response.

includeRawContent.description: Defines whether the API should include the raw page content and its content type in the response.

renderJs.description: Defines whether the API should render the JavaScript of the webpage.

mode.description: Defines the fetch strategy. Pro fetch delivers significantly higher success rates on hard-to-retrieve pages.

instructions.description: Optional instructions that guide how data is extracted. Requires schema.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema of type object describing the structured data to extract from the page. Fields with no grounded value are omitted, even when marked as required.

url.description: The URL of the webpage you want to fetch.
